title: A surprise party
instructions: Zeynep annesi için hazırladıkları sürpriz partiyi anlatıyor. Kim ne yaptı, dikkat et.

script.speaker: zeynep
script.text: Last Friday was my mum's fiftieth birthday, so we organised a surprise party.

script.speaker: zeynep
script.text: My dad took her to the cinema, and we got the house ready.

script.speaker: zeynep
script.text: My brother made a big cake, and I put balloons everywhere.

script.speaker: zeynep
script.text: Thirty people came, including her old school friends.

script.speaker: zeynep
script.text: When she opened the door, everybody shouted "Surprise!"

script.speaker: zeynep
script.text: She was so happy that she cried.

questions.feedback: Annesinin ellinci (fiftieth) doğum günüydü. Otuz, gelen kişi sayısı.
questions.evidence: Last Friday was my mum's fiftieth birthday

questions.feedback: Pastayı kardeşi yaptı; Zeynep balonları astı.
